sources.title: Wikipedia: Euchre — Regional variations (dealer's partner must play alone in Canada)

patch.note: Canadian rule: the dealer's partner may not order up the turned card as an assist; ordering up is reserved for the other three players.

text.default: The dealer's partner may not order up the turned card as an assist; if they want the turned suit they must play the hand alone.

patch.note: The alone form stays open to the dealer's partner: ordering up is still possible, but only by playing alone (the Canadian loner).
Round two is unchanged by the Canadian rule; re-stated so the overlay's intent is explicit about scope.
